before.name: Shozo Takahashi
before.description: Shozo Takahashi was a Hawaii-born teacher educated in Japan who returned to Hawaii in 1938. He taught at Hawaii Chuo Gakuin and then Waialae Japanese Language School. JCCH distinguishes an FBI arrest and release in spring 1942 from his March 1943 arrest and Honouliuli incarceration. He was paroled in March 1944 and released from parole in February 1945. After the war he resumed teaching and later led Kaimuki Japanese Language School. Source: https://incarceration.jcchawaii.org/internees/takahashi-shozo
